<function name="CurTime" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Returns the uptime of the server in seconds (to at least 4 decimal places)

This is a synchronised value and affected by various factors such as host_timescale (or <page>game.GetTimeScale</page>) and the server being paused - either by `sv_pausable` or all players disconnecting.

You should use this function for timing in-game events but not for real-world events.

See also: <page>Global.RealTime</page>, <page>Global.SysTime</page>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Time synced with the game server.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Simple delay timer.</description>
	<code>
local delay = 0

hook.Add( "Think", "CurTimeDelay", function()
	if CurTime() < delay then return end	
	print( "This message will repeat every 5 seconds." )
	delay = CurTime() + 5
end)
	</code>
	<output>This message will repeat every 5 seconds.</output>

</example>
